title: Fugitive caught after 28 years
summary: The Delhi Police has arrested a fugitive who had been on the run for 28 years, identified as Dr. Jhatka, in connection with a murder case from 1998. The police operation took place during a wedding, where Bairagi was apprehended. The fugitive had reinvented his identity in Madhya Pradesh.
summary_points: The Delhi Police has arrested Dr. Jhatka after 28 years on the run.
Dr. Jhatka is wanted in connection with a murder case from 1998.
The police operation took place during a wedding, where Bairagi was apprehended.
Bairagi had reinvented his identity in Madhya Pradesh.
title_hi: फुगिवट को 28 साल बाद पकड़ा गया
